mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 3
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM orders WHERE status = 3 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') AS year, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM orders WHERE status = 3 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 3 AND oi.product_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.id, p.name, CONCAT(#{baseUrl}, p.img_dir, p.main_img) AS mainImg, pr.platform_price AS platformPrice, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalAmount FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_price pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 3 AND oi.product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.img_dir, p.main_img, pr.platform_price ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT order_type AS orderType, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM orders WHERE status = 3 GROUP BY order_type
